question: Which crop is also known as ‘golden fibre’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jute**.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jute **is known as the **golden fibre**. 
 
• **Jute** is known as **golden fibre** because of its **shiny brown colour**.
 
 
• Jute is the crop of **hot and humid climates**.
 
• It requires a **high temperature** (**24o C to 35o C**) and** heavy rainfall** of 120 to 150 cm.
 
• **Sowing period**- March-April to May-June.
 
• **Harvesting period**- July to October.
 
• **Uses**- gunny bags, ropes, strings, carpets, rugs and clothes, tarpaulins, and decoration pieces.
 
• **Grown in** West Bengal, Assam and Bihar.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cotton**

 
 
• Temperature- **Warm and humid** (20o C to 30o C) and a lot of **s****unshine.**
 
• **Rainfall- 55 to 100 cm.**
 
• **Sowing period**- June-July
 
• **Harvesting period**- December- January.
 
• It requires **frost-free days**.
 
• **States**- Gujrat is the leading producer followed by Maharashtra, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh.
 
 
 
• Fibre can be obtained from various sources.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59f0c155de467daf3d04682277c5bba6cfc89ee12d8859aba03a31dca7ab3c3f.png] 

 
• Natural Fibre: Natural fibres are the fibres that are obtained from plants, animals or mineral sources. Some examples are cotton, silk, wool etc.
 
• Synthetic fibres: Synthetic fibres are the man-made polymers designed to make a fabric. Polymers are obtained when many small units are joined together chemically. Some examples are silk, acrylic, rayon, dacron etc.
